title: LG — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for LG.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Life is Good." LG built its appliance reputation on the Inverter Linear Compressor — a motor technology that uses fewer moving parts for better efficiency and a 10-year warranty. They pioneered InstaView (knock twice to illuminate the glass panel), Craft Ice (slow-melting round ice), and TurboWash 360. LG consistently wins JD Power awards for customer satisfaction.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Families who want mega capacity, smart features, and strong warranties. Customers upgrading from builder-grade who want a noticeable step up without going luxury.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for LG:

• InstaView — knock twice and the glass panel lights up so you can see inside without opening the door

• Craft Ice makes slow-melting round ice balls automatically — huge wow factor

• TurboWash 360 cuts wash time to 30 minutes with 5 spray jets

• 10-year warranty on Inverter Linear Compressor — longest in the industry

• AI DD washer detects fabric texture and weight, then selects the optimal wash motion
